title: Playing professor in the sporting houses
summary: Amacker explains how the house piano player worked: playing, passing the hat, and the price of drinks.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: Hmm. Let me ask you if you remember a piece. I'm going to turn the machine off for a second. I know what's up there.

I'm forgetting. What's the name of that? You go to hell, you go to hell, you go to hell. I said you go to hell, you go to hell. Man, things that saves you for the play that kind of stuff in the whole house. I used to play things like that. Sam Hennessy plays things like that. Pack your plays. In those days, all the fall I needed to do was tell you something. Everybody called a professor in that day, you know. Play three tunes. Now I'm playing in this house, in this house, the whole house, yeah. I'm hard to sit here and play. All right, now I'll put you at 9 o'clock. I'm going to play me to open the house up with a red. Some fast red. Now, I might play three tunes. If nobody don't come in those three tunes, I come on out. And I'm going back to where I was standing up at. I was sitting around. And if someone come in there while I'm gone, then the lady get on the phone and call up. Tell the professor to come right away, got company in the house. And when I come back, I walk in the house, I go to the piano, start playing a piece. After I play two, three tunes, come in the piano, get my hat off the piano, pass it around and cry. Come on, give me some money for the piano player. Show the piano player. They may tip me or whatever they put in there. I'll pay three or four more, get my hat. I don't care if you put ten dollars in there. After three more tunes, come get the hat and stay right there till you're good. And if you stay in there all night, as long as you stay in there, I'll take my hat and pass that to you. And if you spend a thousand dollars there, as soon as you got broke, the horse comes. I tell you to do it. Say, well I'm sorry. You can't stay in yellow mode. You have to get out of here. Get out of here. Get out of here. Get out of here.
Get out of here. Get out of here.

That big cause I saw him from front of the night, put out like a dog after, 75 bottles of beer. Those days a bottle cost you a dollar a bottle. See? In those houses. In those houses. They say, for 75 bottles, it kicked him out the street after he spent 75 dollars.
